verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover the whole loop. Raw conversations are sent in and memories are extracted automatically, with customId for incremental conversation updates. Memories are embedded and immediately searchable, and SDK examples show `client.add` and `client.search` with hybrid semantic search. Container tags scope memories per user, so they persist and can be recalled across sessions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of recall quality across sessions; all evidence is vendor-claimed.
